about.title: Good taste takes time.
about.intro: Chronos is a study in considered collecting. A space to slow down, look closely, and discover the details that make an object worth keeping.
about.heading: Objects with a point of view.
body: A watch is both useful and deeply personal. Its proportions, materials and small rituals become part of the way we move through a day.
Our collection explores three different characters: the understated Nocturne, the warm Meridian, and the blue-dial Pelagic. Each is an original fictional concept created for this storefront preview.

This is an independent portfolio demonstration, not an established watch manufacturer. The products, specifications and prices illustrate the shopping experience; no items are offered for sale in this preview.

privacy.title: Your privacy, considered.
body: Chronos is a portfolio demo developed by Zahidul Islam, not a retailer. This notice describes this public demo; no account, order, payment, newsletter subscription or contact-message database is created.

Your selection is saved in browser local storage only after you add an item. It contains concept product details and quantities, not payment or account information. It stays on this browser until you remove the items or clear it below. If storage is blocked, you can still explore and make a temporary selection.

Contact notes remain in the open page. The copy button writes your note to your device clipboard only when you request it. The site does not send the note to us. Avoid entering sensitive information on shared devices.

The site is delivered through Cloudflare and hosted by Contabo. Delivering and protecting a website involves processing network data such as IP addresses, request details and browser information. We use this infrastructure to serve the site, diagnose failures and prevent abuse. Routine application access logging is disabled in this release; diagnostic and provider security records may still be processed.

We do not add advertising, behavioural analytics, tracking pixels or social-media embeds. Cloudflare may use security cookies when protecting requests. Its processing can involve countries outside your own, including the United States. Provider privacy notices explain their practices; we do not claim that infrastructure processing is anonymous or that all provider records have the same retention period.

No personal information is sold or shared for cross-context behavioural advertising by this demo. It does not build advertising profiles and does not change this behaviour when a Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track signal is present.

Privacy questions can be directed through the developer contact profile linked below. Do not post private data in a public issue or discussion. Depending on the law that applies to you, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to processing, obtain portable data, and complain to a supervisory authority. Rights and applicable exceptions depend on the processing and jurisdiction.

This demo is not directed to children and does not solicit their personal information. Before real sales, account collection or marketing is introduced, the operator must publish the applicable business identity, lawful bases, retention schedule, transfer safeguards and request process. This demo notice is not a substitute for that launch review.

terms.title: A note on this collection.
body: Chronos is an independent portfolio demonstration by Zahidul Islam. Nocturne, Meridian and Pelagic are fictional design concepts. Displayed prices, stock states, materials and specifications illustrate the interface; they are not verified product performance claims or offers for sale.

No contract to purchase goods is formed here. Checkout, payments and account registration are disabled. Adding an item to the bag only changes your local demonstration selection. No shipping, delivery date, return promise or commercial warranty is offered by this demo.

Watch, lifestyle and movement imagery includes AI-generated images and video, with creative direction and editing for this project. These are illustrations, not photographs of goods available for delivery. The exploded movement is an imaginative visual study, not a technically accurate assembly or repair guide.

Product and project names do not imply affiliation with, authorization by or endorsement from an established watch manufacturer. Do not infer exclusive copyright ownership in purely AI-generated elements. Third-party components and fonts remain subject to their respective licences.
The journal contains general design commentary rather than professional repair, investment or purchasing advice. Nothing in these demo terms excludes non-waivable rights under applicable law.

For project feedback, privacy or accessibility questions, use the developer profile linked on the contact and privacy pages. Do not submit passwords, payment details or other sensitive information in public feedback.

accessibility.title: A considered experience for everyone.
body: Chronos supports keyboard navigation, a skip-to-content link, labelled controls and browser zoom. Product information is presented as text alongside imagery.

The cinematic sequences respond to the reduced-motion preference in your device or browser and use static image fallbacks when motion is reduced or video cannot load. The silent visual sequences contain no spoken instructions or essential information available only in audio.
The collection and journal remain readable without JavaScript. Interactive filters, gallery controls and the demo bag need JavaScript; ordinary page links remain available.
Automated and manual checks support ongoing improvements, but do not establish that every assistive technology or every WCAG requirement has been verified. We do not claim certified legal conformity.
If you encounter a barrier, use the developer contact profile on the contact page. Describe the page, browser and assistive technology if you wish; avoid sharing private information.
